name: San Salvador de Jujuy
discoveryMethod: Separate first-party English and Argentine-Spanish discovery, official provincial custodian review, current IDEJUY GeoNode map/config inspection, WFS capabilities/schema inspection, and bounded anonymous WFS ID-plus-geometry retrieval.
queryOutcomes: Both discovery languages identified official Jujuy provincial cadastral custody and the IDEJUY Catastro Parcelario viewer. The current map configuration exposed a DPI WMS endpoint; the same public host also exposed WFS 2.0 capabilities and parcel layers. A bounded EPSG:4326 WFS query around the immutable WUP point matched 60 features in salvador:parcelas_A-1-12 and returned three full MultiPolygon features for the retained sample.

attempts.query: San Salvador de Jujuy Argentina official cadastral map parcel viewer catastro municipal
attempts.outcome: Official municipal, provincial Dirección Provincial de Inmuebles, and IDEJUY parcel viewer results found.

attempts.query: San Salvador de Jujuy Argentina catastro visor parcelas oficial municipio
attempts.outcome: Official Departamento Catastro, IDEJUY Visor Geográfico, and municipal MuniMap results found; no separate municipal parcel WFS was established.
Official provincial site returned; page source linked Visor Geográfico / Catastro Parcelario at IDEJUY.
Official GeoNode map page returned. Current JavaScript/configuration identified map 39 and public DPI WMS source.
Current map JSON returned; title/abstract identify Catastro Parcelario and configuration names the DPI WMS endpoint http://dpinmuebles.ddns.net/dpicatastro.php.
WMS capabilities returned with layer DPI, EPSG:4326/EPSG:3857/EPSG:22183/CRS:84, and a Jujuy bounding box.
WFS 2.0 capabilities returned with parcel layers, application/json output support, EPSG:4326 bounding boxes, and provider Dirección Provincial de Inmuebles.
Schema returned geometry plus native fields. Unsafe attribute fields were not requested in the feature query.
Bounded anonymous hits request returned numberMatched=60 for the layer around the immutable WUP point.

Returned three full native MultiPolygon geometries with WFS feature ids parcelas_A-1-12.1512, parcelas_A-1-12.1784, and parcelas_A-1-12.1794. Retained GeoJSON properties contain only the canonical id.

TLS handshake failed with OpenSSL unsafe legacy renegotiation disabled; no certificate exception was used and this route was not treated as unavailable cadastral evidence because the official IDEJUY route succeeded.

sourceAssessment.localCustodian: The evidenced custodian is provincial, Dirección Provincial de Inmuebles / Departamento Catastro of Jujuy, headquartered in San Salvador de Jujuy. The Municipality is separately evidenced as a local government and announced MuniMap, but the executed public parcel source is provincial.
sourceAssessment.publicService: DPI public WFS endpoint https://dpinmuebles.ddns.net/dpicatastro.php, WFS 2.0.0, layer salvador:parcelas_A-1-12 for the bounded sample; IDEJUY map 39 also publishes the DPI WMS layer.
sourceAssessment.nativeFieldsObserved: the_geom, OBJECTID, AREA, PERIMETER, DEPARTA, CIRCUNS, SECCION, MANZANA, PARCELA, SUBPARCELA, NOMENCLA, COD, N_POSTAL, CALLE, TIPOI, ESPECIFICO, OBSERVA, PADRON. Only the WFS feature id and geometry were retained.
sourceAssessment.compositeKeyProvenance: The native feature id includes the source layer namespace and source feature key. No synthetic row number or reconstructed cadastral composite key was used.

scopeLimits: One bounded urban layer was queried; no claim of citywide completeness is made.
A bounded match count is evidence of service response, not a parcel inventory or runtime adapter qualification.
The official metadata says the cartography is orientative and not approving plan information.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS-disable was used.
Research completion does not constitute source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification.
uncertainty: The public source and native geometry are verified, but layer partitioning, update cadence, city-boundary completeness, identity semantics across all layers, and independent runtime adapter qualification remain unresolved.
pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point; retained exactly and not shifted to seek a parcel hit.
